en: Commentaries on the Scriptures of the Sanlun School, compiled by the Vinaya Master An’yo of Enryaku-ji in accordance with the Imperial Edict of the Sage King. Recorded and Submitted.

*Fahua yishu* (Commentary on the Meaning of the Lotus Sūtra), twelve fascicles, composed by Hu Jizang of Jiaxiang Temple. *Fahua xinzhuan shu* (Newly Composed Commentary on the Lotus Sūtra), six fascicles; divided into original and supplementary parts totaling twelve fascicles, composed by Jizang.
*Fahua tonglue* (Comprehensive Summary of the Lotus Sūtra), three fascicles; divided into original and supplementary parts totaling six fascicles, composed by Jizang.

*Fahua youyi* (The Intent of the Lotus Sūtra), one fascicle, composed by Jizang. *Fahua lueshu* (Abridged Commentary on the Lotus Sūtra), two fascicles, composed by Jizang. *Niepan yishu* (Commentary on the Meaning of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), twenty fascicles, composed by Zhu Daosheng. *Niepan youyi* (The Intent of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), one fascicle, composed by Jizang. *Niepan lueshu* (Abridged Commentary on the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), fifteen fascicles, composed by Jizang. *Niepan yiji* (Record of the Meaning of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), ten fascicles; divided into original and supplementary parts totaling twenty fascicles, composed by Fabao.

Huiyuan composed the *Brief Commentary on the Vimalakīrti-nirdeśa* in five fascicles; Jizang composed the *Extensive Commentary on the Vimalakīrti-nirdeśa* in six fascicles; Jizang composed the *Treasury of the Śrīmālā-sūtra* in three fascicles (later divided into six fascicles);
Jizang composed the *Commentary on the Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra* in one fascicle (alternatively in two fascicles);

Jizang composed the *Commentary on the Vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā-sūtra* in four fascicles; Jizang composed the *Brief Commentary on the Pañcaviṃśati-sāhasrikā-prajñāpāramitā-sūtra* in four fascicles; and Jizang composed the *Extensive Commentary on the Pañcaviṃśati-sāhasrikā-prajñāpāramitā-sūtra*.

*Da-pǐn bōrě yóuyì* (The Meaning of the *Mahāprajñāpāramitā-sūtra*), ten fascicles, composed by Jizang; *Yùlán pén jīng shū* (Commentary on the *Ullambana Sūtra*), one fascicle, composed by Jizang; *Mílè jīng yóuyì* (The Meaning of the *Maitreya Sūtra*), one fascicle, composed by Jizang;

*Huáyán jīng yóuyì* (The Meaning of the *Avataṃsaka Sūtra*), one fascicle, composed by Jizang; *Rénwáng jīng shū* (Commentary on the *Śūraṅgama Samādhi Sūtra*), two fascicles, composed by Jizang; *Guān wúliàngshòu jīng shū* (Commentary on the *Amitāyurdhyāna Sūtra*), one fascicle, composed by Jizang;

*Guān wúliàngshòu jīng yìjì* (Record of the Meaning of the *Amitāyurdhyāna Sūtra*), one fascicle, composed by Jizang; *Fǎhuá lùn shū* (Commentary on the *Lotus Sūtra Treatise*), three fascicles, composed by Jingying and Jizang.

*Zhonglun shu* (Commentary on the *Mūlamadhyamakakārikā*), ten fascicles, composed by Jizang; *Zhonglun xuan* (Profound Meaning of the *Mūlamadhyamakakārikā*), one fascicle, composed by Jizang; *Zhonglun shu* (Commentary on the *Mūlamadhyamakakārikā*), six fascicles, two hundred and sixty-nine sheets, composed by Falang of Xinghuang Temple;
*Qixin lun shu* (Commentary on the *Mahāyānaśraddhotpāda-śāstra*), two fascicles, forty-seven sheets, composed by Huiyuan.
Wonhyo composed the *Commentary on the Awakening of Faith* in two fascicles, totaling eighty-six sheets;
Fazang composed the *Commentary on Zhaolun* in three fascicles, totaling ninety-six sheets.

Yuan Kang’s *Jingming xuanyan lun* (Mysterious Discourse on the Vimalakīrti), eight fascicles; Ji Zang’s *Fahua xuanyan lun* (Mysterious Discourse on the Lotus Sutra), ten fascicles; Ji Zang’s *Dacheng xuanyan lun* (Mysterious Discourse on the Mahāyāna), five fascicles; Ji Zang’s *Erdi zhang* (Chapter on the Two Truths), three fascicles; Ji Zang’s *Dacheng yi zhang* (Chapter on Mahāyāna Meanings), twenty fascicles; Huiyuan’s *Chengshi lun yi zhang* (Chapter on the Meaning of the *Tattvasiddhi-śāstra*), twenty fascicles; Huiying’s *Jingming xuanti* (Record of the Mysterious [Meaning of] the Vimalakīrti), four fascicles; Japanese Zhiguang’s *Yicheng foxing jiujing lun* (Ultimate Treatise on the One Vehicle Buddha-nature), six fascicles; Fabao’s *Yicheng foxing jiujing lun ji* (Record of the Ultimate Treatise on the One Vehicle Buddha-nature), six fascicles; Qingjun of Dajian Monastery’s *Dacheng yi zhang* (Chapter on Mahāyāna Meanings), three fascicles; Kumārajīva’s *Dacheng pusa rudao sanzhong guan* (Threefold Contemplation for Entering the Path of Mahāyāna Bodhisattvas), one fascicle; Kumārajīva’s *Erdi souxuan lun* (Discourse Searching the Mystery of the Two Truths), one fascicle; and the works of Master Tai—these comprise sixty-nine sections in total.
